name: Kamiouji Koto
source:
Yuuichi's classmate.

Koto is the only daughter of the wealthy and well-connected Kamiouji family. As would be expected for an ojou-sama character, she has been sheltered for a good part of her life. Due to her upbringing, she is very docile and more likely to follow than lead.

Koto joins the Occult Study Group out of sheer curiosity, or so she claims.

[Taken from a [url=http://moroboshiyuumei.livejournal.com/19183.html?thread=24047]review[/url] by Moroboshi Yuumei]
